tool_arguments.prompt:
Create NEW hand-painted pose drawings from scratch, using the attached adopted neutral solely as exact character identity and drawing-style reference. This is a production sprite image, not a character redesign. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Make a TALL PORTRAIT canvas (1024x1536 or larger native portrait) with EXACTLY THREE separate complete drawings in ONE VERTICAL COLUMN, top/middle/bottom in the order below; each drawing large, centered in its own equally sized band, with generous transparent gutter and padding. No panel boxes, letters, labels, floor, shadow, colored backdrop, effect/speed lines, sparkles, water or props. Preserve the reference warm brown contour, same thin-to-medium edge, simple dot eyes, soft watercolor/paper texture contained entirely within painted silhouette, color blocks, head/body proportions and simplification. Do not become realistic, do not add costume or human limbs. Small orange/red crab; two stalked dot eyes, exactly four curved walking legs on EACH side, one SMALL pincer at viewer left and one GREAT pincer at viewer right. Pincers stay on the same body sides through every pose. The three poses must have the same anatomical size and stationary support/body center; do not fit them independently or enlarge quieter poses. Show every appendage without clipping or overlap with other rows.
1. cheer: Celebration with both original pincers raised; preserve asymmetric sizes and all eight walking legs.
2. species_a: Raise only the single reference-large claw slightly; keep the small claw, eyestalks and walking legs steady.
3. species_b: Lift that same large claw a little more upright and slightly open its existing pincer; return through phase A.

original_output.availability: Historical tool location; bundled saved_output is the usable original.
